caption: Drawdown path for the ECI countercyclical Long/Cash rule and buy-and-hold SPY. In OOS the strategy's max drawdown is -4.4% versus -23.9% for buy-and-hold — achieved by stepping to CASH (not shorting) when the lagged wage-stress probability was high. Read the Sharpe advantage as volatility / drawdown avoidance, not forecasting skill, since the indicator is lagging. Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
narrative_alignment_note: Drawdown from the saved quarterly return series; frames Sharpe as vol avoidance.
